[[Image:Alchemy_Bod.png]] '''Alchemy Bulk Order Deeds''' are [[Bulk Order Deed]]s for the [[Alchemy]] [[skill]] and were introduced in November of 2016 with [[Publish 95]]. A character only needs one-tenth of a skill point in Alchemy to be eligible to receive a BOD from an alchemist [[NPC]] in a mage shop. Different BOD types are given out according to skill. BODs are limited to one every six hours; however, NPCs will cache up to 18 hours (or three BODs) worth of give-outs.

==BOD turn-in points==
* There are five different [[Alchemy]] Large Bulk Order Deeds as shown by the table below, with the items listed to fill each of them.
* 70 skill in Alchemy is required to have a chance at receiving Large Bulk Order Deeds.
